# FFDNet Third-Party Files

This folder contains files copied from the public `ffdnet-pytorch` implementation:
- Source: https://github.com/m-tassano/ffdnet
- Original author: Matias Tassano / IPOL
- Included files: `functions.py`, `models.py`, `README.txt`, `models/net_rgb.pth`

The original files state GPL v3+ licensing.
